# Archives of California
> An item-level calendar (finding aid) of the Archives of California, BANC MSS C-A, Bancroft Library: Thomas Savage's 1876–77 copies of the Spanish- and Mexican-era government records of Alta California, whose originals burned in 1906. ~35,000 records across 63 volumes, each with both page systems and a deep link to the manuscript scan. Accuracy is audited and disclosed (see /about and errata.json). Created and maintained by Aodhan Coyne.

## Author
All of these sites are the work of one person: Aodhan Coyne (historian of early California; ORCID https://orcid.org/0009-0002-8630-3768; GitHub https://github.com/Aodhanm). Personal site: https://aodhancoyne.com/

## The connected sites
- https://aodhancoyne.com/ — Aodhan Coyne, personal site
- https://archivesofcalifornia.com/ — Archives of California: item-level calendar of BANC MSS C-A (Savage transcripts), ~35,000 records, 63 volumes, DOI 10.5281/zenodo.21327098
- https://ranchos.archivesofcalifornia.com/ — Ranchos of California: all Spanish and Mexican land grants, DOI 10.5281/zenodo.22185500
- https://ships.archivesofcalifornia.com/ — California Ship Registry, 1769–1846, DOI 10.5281/zenodo.22105908
- https://maps.archivesofcalifornia.com/ — California History Maps: interactive, source-cited cartography
- https://alcaldebooks.com/ — Alcalde Books: curated shop of California and Western Americana
- https://games.aodhancoyne.com/ — browser arcade (personal project)

Data is CC BY 4.0 unless noted. Cite records by their permalink URLs.
